review:
The original 5x3 Magic Piggy, on a magic-show stage. Piggies are mystery symbols, and when a Magic Hat activates them, they all turn into the same thing – either wilds or Bill Stack cash prizes worth 1x to 500x, which add together.

Sometimes a piggy reveals a Multiplier Coin instead, multiplying one to five Bill Stacks by 2x to 5x. With a modest 2,500x cap and medium volatility, it's gentler than most Hacksaw games. 96.2% RTP. A nice relaxed demo.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
